Subject: Renewal discussion: moving to 16 GPUs for Q3 ramp

Hi Ben,

Quick context: Northbridge's product roadmap is shifting more load to generative features starting July. Our internal forecasts show peak inference demand increasing ~2.3x over current baseline. We signed up for an 8 GPU reserved pool this year and want to discuss moving to 16 GPUs as part of the upcoming renewal.

Key asks:
- Updated monthly commit (we can extend the term if that helps pricing).
- Throughput guarantees and guardrails for the expanded pool (we care about sustained token throughput and failover to smaller model variants if an instance becomes unhealthy).
- Activation timeline — we need 16 GPUs available by 2027-08-01 for staged canary.

Can you send a proposal and a short ops activation checklist? Procurement is looped for contracting timelines.

Thanks,
Elena Martinez
Head of Platform
Northbridge AI

Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion: moving to 16 GPUs for Q3 ramp

Elena — thanks for the heads up and the forecast. We can absolutely support a move to 16 GPUs and align the activation with your mid-summer ramp. High level proposal below; attached are a draft amendment and an ops playbook for activation.

Proposal (summary):
- New monthly committed spend: $94,500/month (equivalent of 16 x reserved GPUs, 3-year term pricing pro-rated at renewal).
- One-time activation & capacity reservation fee: $12,000 (covers staged canary, pre-provisioning, and operational runbook support).
- SLA addendum: sustained pool throughput guarantee of 600 tokens/sec (aggregate, measured over a 5-minute window) with a 99.5% availability target. Automatic fallback routing to 8-GPU-compatible variants if any node is unhealthy.
- Billing start: we propose 2027-08-01 for capacity reservation and billing; can do phased billing if preferred.

Ops/activation plan (attached):
- Week 0: Amendment signed + pre-provision capacity.
- Week 1: Canary (10% traffic) with validation prompts + perf/eval baseline.
- Week 2: Ramp to 50% traffic, enable KV caching and autoscaling policies.
- Week 3: Full cutover; enable reserved pool and monitor commit thresholds.

Next steps:
1) Please review Draft_Amendment_NB-2027-16GPU_v2.pdf (attached).
2) If the economics look good, sign the amendment or tell us any specific redlines and we’ll route to legal.
3) Pick a preferred billing start date (we recommend 2027-08-01).

I looped Priyom for onboarding support and Marissa for commercial approvals/discounts.

Best,
Ben Carter

Elena — quick note from the commercial lead. We can move price down by 7.5% off the list monthly commit if you commit to a 12-month renewal term starting 2027-08-01. That would bring the monthly committed amount to $87,509/month.

Couple of guardrails to keep in mind:
- Discount applies to committed monthly spend only; overages billed at standard on-demand rates.
- We’ll include a failure-recovery SLA credit schedule in section 4 of the amendment.
- For the canary, we recommend a dedicated SRE rotation for the first two weeks (we can provide the staffing).

If you want the 3-year term better pricing we can escalate, but this should be competitive for Northbridge’s usage profile.
